_comment: Featured repos, in README order. Star/fork/language come live from the API on every run. 'description' overrides the repo's GitHub description; 'repo' may be "owner/name" for a project you contribute to but don't own; 'name' renames the card when the repo slug isn't what the project is called.

projects.description: A real-time path tracer living inside one WebGL2 fragment shader. Soft shadows, caustics and colour bleeding are never special-cased - they fall out of the rendering equation.
Maxwell's curl equations integrated on a 2D Yee lattice, entirely on the GPU. Interference, diffraction and dispersion come for free - the phenomena a path tracer cannot express.

projects.name: Wellora
projects.description: Hospital management on one append-only EMR. Clinical risk reorders the work instead of interrupting it, and access is enforced by the database rather than the browser.
An academic career platform for faculty. Publications, grants, evidence and appraisals in one record, so nothing that counts toward a career gets lost in an inbox.
